Join our 5x growth journey and help shape the future of People & Talent at Relesys! 🌟 Kick-start your career with hands-on experience in attracting, supporting, and developing great talent in a fast-growing international company.

As our People & Talent Team continues to grow, we're looking for an ambitious and curious intern who wants to explore both recruitment and internal people processes in a fast-growing software company.

If you're passionate about people, thrive in a dynamic environment, and want hands-on experience across the full employee lifecycle, this internship could be your perfect next step. You'll play a meaningful role in helping us attract, onboard, and support the talented people who drive Relesys forward.

You'll support the team across both internal and external talent activities, from ensuring smooth recruitment processes to creating great employee experiences. You'll be part of a team that is always looking for smarter ways of working and new initiatives that support the business.

This is an exciting time to join Relesys. Through our strategic partnership with the Private Equity fund Copilot Capital, the coming years will bring significant growth and plenty of opportunities along the way. You'll have a unique chance to make a real impact, taking both your career and Relesys to the next level. As we like to say, joining a scale-up at this stage is a "once in a lifetime" opportunity! 🤩

**Responsibilities

**As a People & Talent Associate Intern, you will focus on both recruitment and internal administrative tasks. Your responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to...

• Assist on multiple recruitment projects across different profiles and regions, and gradually take on more responsibility of selected projects

• Conduct efficient search&selection processes, and once ramped, perform screening calls to assess candidate skill levels and organizational fit, presenting and recommending candidates to the Hiring Team accordingly

• Maintain our job portal and job posts to ensure consistency and quality of our candidate experience

• Assist in onboarding processes in the creation of onboarding plans and communication with new employees

• Assist in the maintenance of employee records and files, including updating information in the company's people management systems

• Schedule and coordinate internal meetings to ensure smooth operations

• Assist in the execution of internal and external events, such as company thriving events and external employee branding events

• Articulate our value proposition in a way that engages and motivates active and passive candidates to join us on the Relesys growth journey

• Assisting with the creation and distribution of employee communications, such as internal announcements or updates to the Employee Handbook

• Support in the research and development of the Talent department's processes and tools for the purpose of making us even better

• Take part in assisting and managing our internal Relesys app and contribute proactively to its evolvement

• Assists on admin tasks and ad hoc

Who are you?

• You are currently enrolled in a PBA, bachelor's or master's program within the fields of HRM, Psychology, Business Process and Administration or Communication

• Strong sense of structure and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks efficiently

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively interact with a wide range of stakeholders, including applicants, employees, and team members

• An analytical eye for detail when completing administrative tasks an organizer with a creative mind who loves structure and is eager to learn and develop

• You are not afraid to bring your ideas to the table and challenge the ordinary

• A willingness to adapt to new situations, as well as a proactive approach to problem-solving

• Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative mindset, with the ability to work well as part of a team and build strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders

• It is an advantage if you have familiarity with people management systems and processes, including recruitment and onboarding, training and development, and performance evaluation

• You can work full-time during your internship

• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

• You are located in or near Copenhagen as this internship is on-site 🇩🇰

**What We Offer

**

• "Once in a lifetime" growth opportunity in an aspiring unicorn business that will 5x over the coming 4-5 years backed by the Private Equity fund, Copilot Capital

• Positive, collaborative, and supportive colleagues who wish you to succeed

• Opportunities for professional growth and development as we are growing towards becoming a unicorn business

• Lots of challenges and opportunities, with respect and flexibility for your education

• Targeted feedback and guidance from your mentor to further improve your skills

• Delicious lunch scheme with cake every Thursday 🥗

• Homemade buns every Wednesday made by our lovely Piccoline

• Free barista coffee, tea, and a fridge filled with soda

• Our stylish Nordhavn office, just 100 meters from Orientkaj Metro, offers easy access to public transport and stunning ocean views

• Thriving Culture Club that plans Friday bars, Summer parties, Christmas Parties and many other social events!

**When do you start?

**

• Our Talent Programme is custom-tailored for your internship period. However, we are looking for an intern to start in February 2027

• We cannot wait to review your application and meet our future colleagues! 🙌

• Apply for the position by sending your CV through the Apply button

We can't wait to hear from you! 🤩

Who are we?

Relesys isn't just another SaaS company; we are a dynamic force revolutionizing communication and performance management platforms. Established in 2014, we set out on a mission to bridge the gap between HQ and non-desk workers, fostering a thriving workforce.

What value do we bring? People are the heartbeat of our client's business. When employees are thriving and successful, businesses flourish and retention rates increase. Relesys enables our clients to achieve this through an all-in-one app that streamlines communications, training, and daily operations into their own customized and ever-evolving app📱

With clients such as Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, and Vestas - to name just a few - Relesys serves clients in 15 different countries, supporting them in 40 languages with +500,000 licenses across 20,000 stores and users in +100 countries. We have a strong presence in the Nordics and EMEA, and we continue to increasingly attract clients from across the globe, as we are breaking into new, dynamic markets.

At Relesys, we're shaping the future for frontline workers across various industries: Retail, Hospitality, Production/Manufacturing, and Transportation – while having FUN, as our rule number one! Join us on this thrilling journey as we grow and venture into new horizons.

Our Culture

Building a world-class organization and culture is our highest priority. We believe in the talent of our people and in long-term collaborations where we value an informal yet highly professional culture. We always go 'the extra mile' for our colleagues and clients, but rule number one - Have fun! This rule is always at the forefront of our minds when we come to work, creating an environment that is filled with passion, energy, and inspiration. We are eager to see what exciting contributions you, as our new colleague, will bring, as we believe that each and every individual has a tremendous influence on the whole 🌍

**About The Company

**Founded in 2019, Novutech is a dynamic digital transformation partner with a team of over 60 consultants across Europe. We specialize in finance-focused digital transformation projects for international scale-ups and mid-sized enterprises. Our expertise lies in leveraging a core tech stack and the experience from hundreds of successful projects. We are committed to designing, delivering, and supporting end-to-end solutions that drive growth and efficiency.

• Contribute to internal projects fostering innovation and growth through entrepreneurial ideas and OKRs.

Why joining Novutech?

• Be part of a fast-growing company with a startup spirit, and enjoy a friendly environment with tremendous colleagues and a hybrid work setup.

• Experience a place where you can grow, learn, and make a significant impact.

• Benefit from a good work-life balance, fostering both personal and professional well-being.

• Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with attention to detail.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative, international team.

• Entrepreneurial spirit and drive for continuous improvement.

• Willingness to travel occasionally within Europe as required.

If you are excited about the opportunity to make a difference and grow with us, we want to hear from you! Join Novutech and be part of an adventure that’s shaping the future of digital transformation.

jobs.occupation: Research Assistants in Medical Robotics (Navigation & Control)
jobs.description:
The Department of Computer Science invites applications for one-year research assistant positions focused on developing innovative robot control and navigation techniques using simulation-based learning for medical robotic endoscope devices.

  Project Background

• Image-Based Navigation: Creating reward functions for scoring navigation policies for medical robotic devices moving inside the human body, relying solely on image information and accounting for environment changes through interaction models.

jobs.occupation: PhD Project in Photonic Quantum Error Correction
jobs.description:
The Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme (NQCP) is expanding its talented and international team to add to its cutting-edge quantum programme in the heart of Copenhagen, Denmark. At the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen, we are running an international quantum computing programme, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, that drives research and innovations at multiple levels - from developing scalable quantum processor technologies to quantum algorithms and applications. The long-term mission of the programme is to develop fault-tolerant quantum computing hardware and quantum algorithms that solve life-science-relevant chemical and biological problems.

  NQCP invites applicants for a PhD fellowship on fault-tolerant photonic quantum computing with qudits and group surface codes.

  Start date 1 April 2027 or after agreement.

  The project
 Quantum computers promise to solve problems beyond the reach of conventional computers, but their fragile quantum states are easily disturbed by noise. Quantum error correction protects information against these errors. This project will explore new error-correction methods for quantum computers that use photons, the particles of light. In particular, it will investigate photonic qudits, which can carry information in more than two states, and a promising family of error-correcting codes called group surface codes.

  You will develop theoretical models and software to investigate how these codes can be implemented using photonic circuits. Through numerical simulations, you will study how well they protect information, how they allow computations to be performed reliably, and what resources they require. The aim is to identify approaches that could make large-scale photonic quantum computers more efficient. The work focuses on theory, programming and numerical simulation, while maintaining a close connection to photonic hardware. The project is supported by the Danish e-Infrastructure Consortium (DeiC).

  Who are we looking for?
 We are looking for a motivated candidate with a background in physics, quantum information, computer science, mathematics, photonics or a related field, and a strong interest in fault-tolerant quantum computing.

  Relevant qualifications include:

   	
• A solid foundation in quantum mechanics and quantum information. 	
• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and an interest in scientific software development and numerical methods. 	
• Knowledge of quantum error correction, quantum computing architectures, quantum optics or topological quantum codes. Experience in one or more of these areas is an advantage. 	
• Experience with numerical simulations, decoding algorithms or high-performance computing is an advantage. 	
• A curious mindset, the ability to work independently and collaboratively, and a structured approach to research. 	
• Good written and spoken English and strong communication skills.   Applicants are not expected to have prior experience in all aspects of the project. Relevant research projects, software contributions, publications and other professional activities will be considered in the assessment.

  Our group and research - and what do we offer?
 The group is part of the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen. We are located in Copenhagen.We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment hosted by NQCP at. You will be part of the photonics research environment and collaborate closely with researchers working on quantum computing architectures, quantum error correction and photonic quantum technologies.

  Principal supervisor is Associate Professor Stefano Paesani, Niels Bohr Institute, stefano.paesani@nbi.ku.dk. The co-supervisor will be Professor Apoorv Tiwari at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU). The project will involve close collaboration between the two institutions, with regular joint supervision meetings and in-person visits.

  Joining NQCP now, you will get involved in a well-established and ambitious programme, which offers excellent opportunities to build a career in advancing quantum computing. We want to make Denmark a world leader in quantum research, and we hope to attract people from all over the world.

  Life in Denmark is supported by strong social services, including universal healthcare, free or subsidised language courses, paid parental leave, subsidised day care and excellent public schools. Our work culture is egalitarian and prioritises work-life balance. Copenhagen offers excellent infrastructure, extensive cycling networks, a thriving food scene, museums and access to beautiful natural surroundings.

  The PhD programme 
 Depending on your level of education, you can undertake the PhD programme as:

  Option A: A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme), if you already have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree.

  Option B: An up to five year full-time study programme within the framework of the integrated MSc and PhD programme (the 3+5 scheme), if you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master´s degree – but you have an education equivalent to a Danish bachelors´s degree.

   Option A: Getting into a position on the regular PhD programme 

  Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Physics For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure. 

  Appointment will be subject to a security clearance.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

   Option B: Getting into a position on the integrated MSc and PhD programme

  Qualifications needed for the integrated MSc and PhD programme 

  If you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master´s degree, you might be qualified for the integrated MSc and PhD programme, if you have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish bachelor´s degree. Here you can find out, if that is relevant for you: General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database. 

  Terms of the integrated programme
 To be eligible for the integrated scholarship, you are (or are eligible to be) enrolled at one of the faculty’s master programmes in Physics.

  Students on the integrated programme will enroll as PhD students simultaneously with completing their enrollment in this MSc degree programme.

  The duration of the integrated programme is up to five years, and depends on the amount of credits that you have passed on your MSc programme. For further information about the study programme, please see: www.science.ku.dk/phd, “Study Structures”.

  Until the MSc degree is obtained, (when exactly two years of the full 3+5 programme remains), the grant will be paid partly in the form of 48 state education grant portions (in Danish: “SU-klip”) plus salary for work (teaching, supervision etc.) totalling a workload of 150 working hours per year.

  A PhD grant portion is currently (2026) DKK 7.426 before tax.
 
 When you have obtained the MSc degree, you will transfer to the salary-earning part of the scholarship for a period of two years. At that point, the terms of employment and payment will be according to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Appointment will be subject to a security clearance.

   Responsibilities and tasks in both PhD programmes

   	
• Complete and pass the MSc education in accordance with the curriculum of the MSc programme  (ONLY when you are attending the integrated MSc and PhD programme) 	
• Carry through an independent research project under supervision    	
• Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE 	
• Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad 	
• Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities 	
• Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals 	
• Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project   We are looking for the following qualifications:

   	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project. 	
• Relevant publications. 	
• Relevant work experience. 	
• Other relevant professional activities. 	
• Curious mind-set with a strong interest in Physics. 	
• Good language and communication skills. 	
• A structures approach to work.   Application and Assessment Procedure
 Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include:

• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor of Science or Master of Science and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. 	
• Publication list (if possible) 	
• Reference letters (if available)   When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

  The deadline for applications is 22 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment by an unbiased expert assessor. You are notified, whether you will be passed for assessment.

  The assessor will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the above mentioned research area, techniques, skills and other requirements. The assessor will conclude whether each applicant is qualified and, if so, for which of the two models. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website: https://www.science.ku.dk/phd/.

jobs.occupation: Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead is a key role within Genmab’s Transformation Office (TO). The Senior Director will be the central orchestrator for operational and strategic initiatives, including initiative intake, prioritization, governance, reporting, and portfolio performance management. You will ensure that Genmab's most strategic initiatives are aligned with organizational priorities and deliver measurable business value. The initial focus of the Transformation Office is on R&D and Tech Ops (approximately 2,000 FTE), with potential for future scope expansion across the enterprise (⁓3,000 FTE).

The Transformation Office Portfolio Lead partners closely with senior business leaders, initiative sponsors, project managers, finance business partners and functional teams to drive rigorous initiative portfolio management, accelerate execution, and provide transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, and value realization.

As a key driver of the Transformation Office, the Senior Director will lead initiative portfolio management processes, develop recommendations on initiative prioritization, sequencing, and TO resource allocation, and ensure decisions are translated into action to maximize organizational impact.

The Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead will report directly to Head of the Transformation Office (currently the SVP, Global Head of PPM & R&D Operations). The position can be located in Plainsboro, NJ, Utrecht, NL or Copenhagen, DK.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own portfolio management for cross-functional transformation initiatives that support Genmab’s financial commitments and strategic objectives

• Support the Transformation Office’s goals and objectives, aligned with the company’s overarching strategy and 2030 Vision

• Lead initiative intake screening, categorization, and prioritization processes, ensuring consistent application of prioritization criteria and governance framework

• Support, challenges and monitors projects, initiatives, and analyses focused on company transformation and productivity gains to inform strategic capital allocation and resourcing decisions

• Collaborate closely with Finance on Genmab’s long-range financial plan and annual budget cycle

• Drive the organization’s ongoing mindset shift toward productivity and prioritization

• Drive execution of initiatives from initiation through closure, ensuring clear ownership, milestones, and follow-through

• Track, report, and communicate TO initiatives to major stakeholders at all governance levels, including progress, risks, dependencies, and value realization

• Define, establish, and continuously monitor Transformation Office portfolio KPIs and success measures, ensuring transparent reporting of initiative performance, value realization, and overall portfolio health

• Lead the coordination and preparation of TO meetings and serve as meeting moderator

• Report on industry trends and peer company developments, translate their impact on Genmab, and improve overall strategic decision-making quality

• Work cross-functionally with R&D, Tech Ops, Commercialization, Finance, Human Resources, DD&AI, and other teams to drive alignment and execution

**Qualifications

****Qualifications and Requirements

**

• A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree in life sciences, business administration, economics or finance required is required; advanced degree (Master's, PhD) preferred.

• Prior management consulting with direct biotech/pharma case experience advising clients on company transformations required

• Prior biotech/pharma operating experience in a Transformation Office capacity and/or program and project management with a Finance background also highly valued

**Requirements

**

• Passionate about life sciences and Genmab’s purpose and mission

• Demonstrated knowledge and expertise to drive company transformations and productivity initiatives

• Experience preparing executive-level materials and presenting recommendations to senior leadership and governance bodies

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills across the different levels within the organization

• Highly organized, attentive to detail, and results-driven, with a strong affinity for financial analysis, business performance metrics, and value realization

• Highly self-motivated, with the ability to take ownership, drive activities independently, and manage multiple priorities

• Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, drive alignment, and achieve outcomes across cross-functional teams without direct authority

• Structured problem-solving skills

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK962.880,00---1.444.320,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Monthio is looking for a Head of Finance with a strong financial foundation and an interest in working closely with the business. You will have overall responsibility for the finance function and a central role in the company's development. Perhaps you already lead a finance function, or perhaps you are an experienced Senior Controller or Finance Business Partner ready to take the next step. Most importantly, you can combine a broad overview with a hands-on approach and thrive with esponsibility for both day-to-day operations and the further development of the finance function. Experience from a similar role is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your role

You will have overall responsibility for financial management, reporting and the ongoing development of Monthio's finance function. You will join the management team, report to the COO and work closely with the CCO and the rest of the management team to provide a true and fair picture of the company's finances and a solid basis for decisions. You will attend board meetings, where you present financial results, expectations and key risks, and you will manage the dialogue with our lender and other external stakeholders.

As the only in-house member of the finance function, you will have a broad role that requires an eye for the whole business and the ability to turn insight into action. Day-to-day bookkeeping and payroll are handled by an external partner. You will manage the partnership, ensure quality and follow up on deliverables. At the same time, you will work hands-on with analyses, models, reporting and processes, and ensure that the finance function supports both daily operations and the company's growth.

Your responsibilities

Budgets, forecasts and liquidity

Drive the budget process and rolling forecasts, and further develop the financial model so that changes in hiring plans, other costs and expected revenue are continuously reflected and provide a basis for adjusting the company's priorities.

Monitor liquidity, cash burn and runway, and make the impact of changes in revenue, costs and investments visible.

Explain variances against budget and forecast, and turn analyses and scenarios into concrete recommendations to management.

Reporting and commercial partnering

Prepare monthly reporting for management and the board, as well as investor reporting, with clear conclusions on performance, expectations and risks.

Prepare board materials together with the COO and the Chairman, and present the key financial points at board meetings.

Consolidate the commercial forecast together with the CCO and ensure consistency between pipeline and forecast.

Accounting and financial control

Ensure a timely and accurate month-end close, including reconciliations, accruals and quality assurance of the accounts, in collaboration with the external partner.

Coordinate the annual report and audit, and ensure follow-up on VAT, tax and other financial filings together with external advisors.

Maintain internal controls and approval procedures, handle payments and ensure correct calculation of sales commissions.

Systems and automation

Drive improvements in finance systems and workflows based on e- conomic, Pleo, Fenerum and Corpay.

Reduce manual work and strengthen data quality through better integrations, automation and relevant use of AI.

Your profile

You master the financial craft, understand the business behind the numbers and take ownership of getting things done. You can challenge assumptions constructively and communicate your conclusions clearly. We value the quality of what you have delivered and your ability to take on broader responsibility.

We imagine that you:

• Hold a relevant degree in finance or business, e.g. cand.merc., cand.merc.aud., HD(R) or equivalent.

• Have solid hands-on experience with financial management and reporting, and an understanding of accounting, budgeting, forecasting and liquidity.

• Have strong analytical skills and can turn complex data into clear insights and concrete recommendations.

• Work independently and in a structured way, and can prioritise between recurring deliverables and developing the finance function.

• Communicate confidently in Danish and English and work well with both colleagues and external partners.

Experience with financial management in a company with large enterprise customers is an advantage, especially if you have worked with ARR, accruals and revenue recognition for large customer contracts. The same applies to experience with board reporting and managing external finance partners. You do not need to have worked with every part of the role beforehand, but you must have the professional foundation and the ability to take overall responsibility and grow in the position.

Perks and benefits

Comprehensive benefits

We offer a pension plan and health insurance so you’re covered from day 1.

Lunch arrangement

With our catered lunches you can choose from a selection of delicious and nourishingoptions.

Flexible working

With our flexible or hybrid working options, you can create a schedule that suits your needs.

Snacks & drinks on tap

Stay fueled and refreshed throughout the day with a variety of snacks and drinks readily available.

Choice of hardware

At Monthio, you have the possibility to choose the hardware that best suits your needs and preferences.

Social activities

Whether it's sports, dining out, board games, or even starting your own group, you'll have the opportunity to bond with your colleagues and share your favourite hobby.

Multimedia package

Enjoy a flexible multimedia package that includes a phone, allowing you to choose what works best for you.

Convenient & green location

Located next to one of Copenhagen’s nicest parks, Monthio is easy to access from public transport, and perfectly situated for walking meetings.

How Monthio hires

1

The first call

Let's connect! We'll chat about your experience and aspirations

2

The interview

Time to shine! Show us your skills and passion for the role.

3

Meet the team

Get to know the amazing individuals who make up our dynamic team.

4

Welcome to Monthio!

Congratulations on your new role! Let’s embark on an exciting journey together!

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

jobs.description:
Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen
 
 The Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports at the University of Copenhagen invites applications for a Professorship in Human Nutrition and Health. 

  We seek a colleague who brings strong scientific leadership, a collaborative spirit, and a deep commitment to advancing research and education in human nutrition and health. The candidate will be joining a dynamic and interdisciplinary department dedicated to excellence in research, teaching and societal impact

  The ideal candidate will have:

   	
• A strong track record of shaping state-of-the-art knowledge in human nutrition, with documented impact on mechanistic understanding of nutritional impact on human health. 	
• Extensive expertise in conducting clinical trials.  	
• Solid teaching and supervisor experience at university level (BSc, MSc and PhD). 	
• An excellent publication record within the area of human nutrition and health.  	
• Proven ability to attract competitive national and international research funding. 	
• A forward looking, realistic 5-year research plan, including clear milestones that demonstrate how your work will enrich and expand the departments experimental research profile.   We particularly welcome applicants excited about strengthening our interdisciplinary research environment.

  The ideal candidate should have:

   	
• Documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon their own teaching practice and portfolio.  	
• Formal pedagogical training and supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme. 	
• Strong leadership and management skills.    The ideal candidate’s responsibilities will include:

   	
• Conducting cutting-edge research and contributing to the continued development of the research area. 	
• Applying for competitive grants and leading research projects. 	
• Supervising, mentoring and training of research fellows and other staff. 	
• Contributing actively to teaching, curriculum development, supervision, examinations and other tasks requested by the Department including administrative academic duties. 	
• Strengthening the Departments mission to deliver research and research-based education at the highest international level.    The candidate will become part of an inspiring and diverse academic community. The research of the department is broad and includes basic physiology, human movement and exercise science, humanities related to exercise and sport as well as diet and nutrition science. 

  Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

  General criteria apply to the appointment of professors at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, innovation and societal impact, organizational contributionand leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. 

  Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen’s Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here.

  Further information about the Department can be found at Department of Nutrition, Exercise and Sports – University of Copenhagen (ku.dk)

  Potential applicants are encouraged to seek further information by contacting Head of Department, Professor Nikolai B. Nordsborg (nbn@nexs.ku.dk; +45 28751612).

  The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect on the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment
 The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Employment is as professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, including all attachments, must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include: 

   	
• Curriculum vitae includes information about external funding. 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent). 	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans. 	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines. 	
• Complete publication list. 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers.   
 The deadline for applications is 22 November 2026, 23:59 CET

  After the expiry date of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held on 30 March 2027

  Please refer to the following number in any communication regarding this position: 211-0372/26-2K

The Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme (NQCP) is expanding its talented and international team to add to its cutting-edge quantum programme in the heart of Copenhagen, Denmark. At the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen, we are running an international quantum computing programme, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, that drives research and innovations at multiple levels - from developing scalable quantum processor technologies to quantum algorithms and applications.  The long-term mission of the programme is to develop fault-tolerant quantum computing hardware and quantum algorithms that solve life-science-relevant chemical and biological problems.

  Start date is the 1st of February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  The project 
 The position is centred on the development of integrated superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) embedded in controllable photonic circuits for the fully integrated processing of the emitted photons from silicon quantum emitters. The work will be performed as part of the Photonic Control and Readout team in NQCP, in close collaboration with the Theory & Simulation and the Materials engineering teams at NQCP and the Growth team at Quantum Foundry. These teams will support the efforts of the development and integration of SNSPDs in our photonic circuit.

  You will be collaborating closely with the other team members of the Photonic C&R team and – like the rest of the team - be generally involved in the projects related to the platform. A number of students will also be dedicated to the SNSPD projects. The nanofabrication is done at the DTU Nanolab – a 1,350 m² ISO 4–6 cleanroom with over 150 state-of-the-art tools, and one of the leading cleanrooms in Europe. Testing and integration of the SNSPDs will be done at the NQCP Photonics lab at the Niels Bohr Institute established in 2023. The lab contains a range of cryostats (mK to 4K) designed for optical fibre access, state-of-the-art electronics, commercial SNSPDs, etc.

  The position is also open as an assistant professor. Please apply to the call corresponding to the position relevant for you.

  Responsibilities:

   	
• Taking the leading role in developing and integrating SNSPDs into our photonic circuits and establishing the electrical control circuit. 	
• Structuring the efforts on multiple projects, integrating experimental results in our database, and providing feedback to collaborating teams. 	
• Contributing to the other projects within the Photonics team. The projects span single photon sources and optical components like switches, cavities, etc. 	
• Teaching and supervision of students. 	
• Procurement, maintenance, and operation of scientific equipment.    

  We are looking for the following qualifications: 

   	
• PhD with postdoc experience in experimental physics, engineering, nanotechnologies, or related. 	
• Experience with SNSPDs fabrication and characterisation, quantum photonics, electronics, and cryogenic systems. 	
• Experience with control software and data logging – preferably in python.   Good communication skills and a structured approach to work.
 
 Why Us? 
 Joining NQCP now, you will get involved in a well-established and ambitious programme, which offers excellent opportunities to build a career in advancing quantum computing. We want to make Denmark a world leader in quantum research, and we hope to attract people from all over the world.  

   

  Life in Denmark is supported with strong social services (free universal healthcare, free/subsidised language courses, paid parental leave, subsidised day care institutions and excellent public schools). Our work culture is very egalitarian and prioritises work life balance. Dual career families are the norm, and workplaces offer flexibility to support everyone in having both an exciting career and good family time. Danish cities are known for having excellent infrastructure, for example through widespread bike path networks. We can also offer a thriving food-scene, excellent museums, and beautiful natural scenery. 

   

  Further information on the Department is linked at Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme – University of Copenhagen, Inquiries about the position can be made to Stefano Paesani: stefano.paesani@nbi.ku.dk or Peter Granum: peter.granum@nbi.ku.dk.

   

  Terms of employment
 The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  Appointment will be subject to receipt of a security clearance.
 
 The position is open from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.
 
 The position is limited in time to 2 years from the date of employment with possible extension. The duration can be negotiated.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background
  

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

   

  When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

  
 Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically.

  Please include 

   	
• Motivation letter (max. one page)      	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position      	
• Original PhD diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish.     	
• Publication list    	
• Reference letters   The deadline for applications is 24th of November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. 

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  We will call for interviews shortly after the application deadline. Interviews are expected to take place in mid-December or early-January.
